spans.s:
f. (-तिः)
1 Spreading, expansion.
2 A creeping plant.
E.
प्र before तन to spread, aff. क्विन्.

f. (-ती)
A creeping plant.
E.
ङीप् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Old, ancient.
E.
प्र prior, with द्युल् aff. and तन् augment.

m. (-नः)
1 Spreading, expansion.
2 A low spreading creeper.
3 A disease, fainting, epilepsy.
E.
प्र before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु)
Thin, delicate, minute.
E.
प्र, and तनु thin.

n. (-णं)
Reasoning, discussion, doubt, logic^1.
E.
प्र before तर्क to reason, aff. ल्युट्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-लः)
The open hand with the fingers extended.
n. (-लं)
One of the seven principal divisions of the lower regions.
E.
प्र exceeding, तल lowness, &c.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Spreading, extending.
f. (-नी)
A spreading, creeper.
E.
प्र before तन to spread, aff. ल्युट्, and इनि and ङीप् added.

m. (-पः)
1 Majesty, dignity, the possession of rank and power.
2 Spirit, energy.
3 Splendour, brilliancy.
4 Heat.
E.
प्र before तप to shine, aff. घञ्.

m. (-नः)
A hell.
n. (-नं)
1 Inflicting pain or punishment, burning, consuming.
2 Paining, distressing.
E.
प्र before तप to heat, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत)
Majestick, glorious.
E.
प्रताप, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-सः)
A species of gigantic Asclepias, with white flowers.
E.
प्रताप heat, षो to destroy, aff. क.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
1 Shining, splendid.
2 Dignified, powerful.
3

Burning.
4

Distressing.
E.
प्रताप, and इति aff.

mfn. (-तान्)
1

Desiring.
2

Being afflicted.
E.
प्र before तम to desire, क्वि aff.

m. (-रः)
Crossing over.
E.
प्र before तॄ to cross, अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A cheat.
E.
प्र before तॄ to cross, aff. ण्वुल्.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Fraud, cheating, deceit, overreaching, trick.
E.
प्र before तॄ to cross, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cheated, deceived, tricked.
E.
प्र before तॄ to pass over, (to overreach,) aff. क्त.

ind.
A particle and prefix, implying,
1 Substitution, (instead, in lieu); as प्रद्युम्नःकेशवातप्रति.
2 Several order, (severally, each by each); as वृक्षं प्रति षिञ्चति; प्रतिवेदं each Vedā; प्रतिदिनं every day; प्रतिछिद्रं each opening; प्रतिगर्भं every birth; प्रत्येक one by one.
3 Direction, designation, (to, towards, upon); as वृक्षं प्रति विद्योतते विद्युत्.
4 Belonging to, (as a part or portion.)
5 Exchange, return, (again, back again, re) तिलेभ्यः प्रति माषान् यच्छति.
6 A little, &c. as शाकप्रति, सूपप्रति.
7 Opposition in place, as प्रतिसूर्य्यं against the sun, प्रतिवात against the wind.
8 With respect to, अनेकभार्य्यं, प्रत्याह.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, डति aff.; in the following compounds the final इ of प्रति is optionally long, before derivatives formed with घञ्, as प्रतिहार or प्रतीहार, &c.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Worth sixteen Pans of Cowries.
E.
प्रति substituted for कार्षापण, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Contrary, adverse.
2 Inverted, reversed, against the natural order or state.
m. (-कः)
1 A limb, a member.
2 A part, a portion.
E.
प्रति before ई to go, ईकन् aff.

f. (-का)
Decrepitude.

n. (-र्म्मा)
1 Dress, decoration, personal embellishment.
2 Retaliation, requital.
3 Remedy, redress.
E.
प्रति belonging to (the body), and कर्म्मन् business.

m. (-यः)
1 A butt, a mark; the effigy of a man, for archers to practise at.
2 An effigy, an image, a picture.
E.
प्रति again, and काय the body; a repetition or reflection of the form.

m. (-रः)
1 Revenge, retaliation.
2 Remedying, counteracting.
E.
प्रति again, against, and कार making; also प्रतीकार.

m. (-रः)
1 Revenge, retaliation.
2 Remedying, obviating, correcting.
3 Remedying, administering medicines.
E.
प्रति against (re), and कार making, re-action, the इ is made long in consequence of the aff. being घञ्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Like, resembling, (used in composition.)
E.
प्रति to or again, and काश or कास what shines; also प्रतिकास, प्रतीकास, &c.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Like, (in composition): see the last.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Like, resembling, (in composition.)
E.
प्रति before काश to shine, aff. घञ्, it is also written प्रतीकाश.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bent, curved.
E.
प्रति, and कुचि to be curved, क्त aff.

m. (-पः)
A moat, a ditch.
E.
प्रति implying little, and कूप a well.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Contrary, adverse, cross-grained, reverse, inverted.
2 Contradictory, cross, perverse.
E.
प्रति for प्रतीप averted, and कूल a bank or shore.

f. (-ता)
Opposition, hostility.
E.
प्रतिकूल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रतिकूलत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Requited, returned.
2

Counteracted.
3

Remedred.
E.
प्रति, and कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
1 An effigy, a figure, an image, a picture, a reflection, a shadow, a reflected image.
2 Retaliation, return, revenge.
3 A substitute.
E.
प्रति again, &c. and कृति making.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Inferior, low, vile.
2 Twice ploughed, or ploughed back again.
E.
प्रति against, and कृष्ट drawn.

f. (-या)
1 Return, requital.
2

Retaliation.
3

Remedying, counteracting.
4 Embellishment, decoration.
E.
प्रति, and क्रिया act.

adv. n. (-णं)
Momentarily, every moment.
E.
प्रति several order, and क्षण an instant.

n. (-णं)
1 Looking to or at, considering, referring to.
2

Respecting.
3

Expecting, waiting for.
E.
प्रति before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-यः)
A guard, an attendant.
E.
प्रति against, क्षय injury.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं).
1 Dismissed, rejected, turned away.
2 Sent, dispatched.
3 Opposed, repelled, resisted.
4 Abused, reviled.
5 Calumniated, falsely accused.
E.
प्रति again, against, and क्षिप्त thrown, sent.

n. (-तं)
Sneezing, wheezing.
E.
प्रति repeatedly, क्षुत sneezing.

n. (-तं)
Flying backwards and forwards, wheeling in flight.
E.
प्रति repetition, and गत gone; going and coming.

mfn. (-र्ज्जन्-र्ज्जन्ती-र्ज्जत्)
Echoing, reverberating.
2 Murmuring or rebelling.
E.
प्रति before गर्ज्ज to growl, शतृ aff.

m. (-रिः)
Any inferior mountain, or any thing like a mountain.
E.
प्रति, and गिरि a hill.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken, accepted.
E.
प्रति, ग्रह to take, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who takes or accepts, an accepter, a receiver.
E.
प्रति before गृह to take, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be taken, what may be accepted, &c.
ind.
1 Having taken.
2 Bringing up the rear.
E.
प्रति, and ग्रह to take, क्यप् or ल्यप् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Acceptance, assent.
2 Proper donation to Brahmans, whatever is a fit present to a Brahman at suitable periods.
3 The acceptance of such a gift.
4 A spitting pot.
5 The reserve of an army, a detachment posted with the general four hundred yards in the rear of the line.
6 The sun near the moon's node.
E.
प्रति again, &c. and ग्रह taking.

m. (-हः)
1 A spitting pot.
2 Accepting gifts.
E.
प्रति before ग्रह to take, ण aff.

n. (-णं)
Receiving presents.
E.
प्रति, and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taken or accepted.
E.
प्रति, ग्रह to take, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be accepted or taken.
E.
प्रति, and ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Adverse, inimical.
m. (-घः)
1 Wrath, rage.
2 Mutual beating, combat, fighting.
3

Fainting.
4

An enemy.
E.
प्रति again, severally, and घ striking.

m. (-तः)
1 A return blow, repulse, rebound.
2 Warding off a blow.
3 Preventing, prohibiting.
E.
प्रति before हन to kill, घञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
Warding off or returning as a blow.
2 Preventing, prohibiting.
E.
प्रतिघात, and the इ made long.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
प्रति mutually, हन to kill, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Repelling, repulsing.
2 Hostile, opposed to.
E.
प्रतिघात, and इनि aff.

n. (-घ्नं)
The body.
E.
प्रति again, घ्न what destroys.

mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्)
1 Opposing, impeding.
2

Destructive.
3

Hostile.
E.
प्रति before हन to kill, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Thinking repeatedly, considering, meditating upon.
E.
प्रति, and चिति to think, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-न्दः)
1 A reflected image, any image, a picture, a statue.
2 A substitute.
E.
प्रति again, छदि to cover, aff. अच्; also with कन् added प्रतिछन्दक n. (-कं.)

f. (-या)
1 An image, a statue, a bas-relief, a picture.
2 A reflected image, a shade or shadow.
E.
प्रति again, छाया a shadow.

m. (-दः)
Opposition, resistance.
E.
प्रति, and छेद cutting.

f. (-ङ्घा)
The fore part of the thigh.
E.
प्रति before, and जङ्घा the thigh.

m. (-कः)
Reply in assent, respectful concurrence.
E.
प्रति, and जल्पक talking.

m. (-रः)
Attention, watchfulness.
E.
प्रति towards, and जागर watchful.

f. (-ह्वा)
The uvula, or soft palate.
E.
प्रति again, or like, जिह्वा the tongue; also with कन् added in the fem. form, प्रतिजिह्विका (-का.)

n. (-नं)
Resuscitation.
E.
प्रति again, जीवन living.

f. (-ज्ञा)
1 Promise, agreement, engagement, assent.
2 Admission, acknowledgment.
3 (In logic,) The proposition, the assertion to be proved.
E.
प्रति mutually, ज्ञा to know, aff. क.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Promised, agreed.
2 Admitted, acknowledged.
3 Propounded, asserted.
E.
प्रति mutually, ज्ञात known.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be promised.
2 To be assented to.
E.
प्रति before ज्ञा to know, तव्य aff.

n. (-नं)
Promise, agreement, assent.
E.
प्रति before ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-रं)
A subsequent proposition on failure of the first, (in logic.)
E.
प्रतिज्ञा, and अन्तर difference.

n. (-कं)
A bond, a written contract.
E.
प्रतिज्ञा agreement, and पच a leaf, कन् added.

ind.
Having promised.
E.
प्रति before, ज्ञा to know, ल्युप् aff.

m. (-धः)
1 Denial of a logical proposition.
2 Acting contrary to promise or agreement.
E.
प्रतिज्ञा, and विरोध opposition.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Promised in marriage, betrothed.
E.
प्रतिज्ञा, and विवाहित married.

m. (-सः)
1 A bandonment of the original proposition, (in logic.)
2 Breaking a promise.
E.
प्रतिज्ञा, and सन्न्यास quitting.

f. (-निः)
Giving up the argument.
E.
प्रतिज्ञा, and हाति abandoning.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be promised or accepted.
m. (-यः)
The reciter or pronouncer of a panegyric, the proclaimer of rank and titles, a herald, a bard, a panegyrist.
E.
प्रति before ज्ञा to know, यत् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
Conclusion or notion adopted by each disputant severally.
E.
प्रति severally, तत्त्व truth, and सिद्धान्त conclusion.

adv. n. (-न्त्रं)
1 According to each

Tantra.
2

According to each opinion, &c.
E.
प्रति, and तन्त्र a doctrine.

m. (-लः)
A kind of air or melody.
f. (-ली)
The key of a door or padlock, or an instrument to open a door.
E.
प्रति relating to, ताल tune, or a lock, fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-नं)
1 The return or re-delivery of a deposit.
2 Barter, exchange.
3 Giving back or in return for.
E.
प्रति again, दानं a giving.

n. (-णं)
War, battle.
E.
प्रति reciprocally, and दारण tearing.

adv. n. (-नं)
Every day, day by day.
E.
प्रति severally, and दिन a day.

m. (-वा)
1 The sun.
2 A day.
E.
प्रति severally, दिव to shine, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्; also with the vowel lengthened, प्रतिदीवन्.

adv. n. (-शं)
Every where, all around.
E.
प्रति, and दिश a quarter.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be returned, to be given back, or as an equivalent.
n. (-यं)
1 A pledge, a pawn.
2 An article purchased and given back.
E.
प्रति again, देय to be given.

n. (-न्द्वं)
Opposition, hostility.
E.
प्रति against, द्वन्द्व a couple.

mfn. (-न्द्वी-न्द्विनी-न्द्वि)
Hostile, an enemy.
E.
प्रतिद्वन्द्व, and इनि aff.

f. (-निः)
Echo, an echo.
E.
प्रति, and ध्वनि sound.

m. (-नः)
Echo, reiterated or repeated sound.
E.
प्रति again, ध्वान sound.

m. (-प्ता)
A great grandson, a son's grandson.
E.
प्रति again, repeated, and नप्तृ a grandson.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
New, young, fresh, recent.
E.
प्रति intensitive prefix, and नव new.

m. (-दः)
Echo, resonance.
E.
प्रति, and नाद sound.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Echoing, re-sounding.
E.
प्रतिनाद, and इतच् aff.

m. (-धिः)
1 A resemblance of a real form, an image, a statue, a picture, &c.
2 A surety.
3 A substitute.
E.
प्रति again, धा to have, with नि prefix, कि aff.

m. (-दः)
An echo, a reverberation.
E.
प्रति, and निनद sound.

n. (-नं)
1 Turning back or away from.
2 Returning.
E.
प्रति, and नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Turned away from, desisted from, leaving, withdrawn from.
2 Come back, returned.
E.
प्रति and नि before वृत to be, क्त aff.

adv. n. (-शं)
By night, every night.
E.
प्रति, and निशा a night.

m. (-पः)
A king of the lunar race, father of ŚANTANU, and grandfather of BHĪṢMA; also प्रतीप.
E.
प्रति severally, and प who cherishes.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Turned away, having the face averted.
2 Backwards, following an order or course the reverse of natural, against the grain or stream.
3 Retrograde, coming back.
4 Disobedient, refractory, perverse.
5 Cross, contradictory.
m. (-पः)
The father of ŚANTANU, and grandfather of BHĪṢMA.
n. (-पं)
Comparing new objects with some established object, as with the moon, &c. inverse comparison.
E.
प्रति before अप् water, and the अ changed to इ by special rule.

m. (-पः)
A name of ŚĀNTANU.
E.
प्रतीप the father of this prince, and अण् aff. of descent.

m. (-क्षः)
1 An enemy.
2 A respondent, an opponent.
3 A defendant.
E.
प्रति against, and पक्ष a part, a party.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
1 Hostile, belonging to an enemy.
2 Adverse, contrary.
E.
प्रतिपक्ष, and अण् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Fame, reputation.
2 Gaining, getting, obtaining, acquirement.
3 Action, worldly practice or activity, as opposed to religious contemplation.
4 Use, application, profit.
5 Arrogance, audacity, confidence.
6 Knowledge, determination, ascertainment.
7 Elevation, exaltation, promotion, acquirement of rank or dignity.
8 Acknowledgment, assent, admission.
9 Inspiring trust or confidence, satisfying, shewing in proof.
10 Respectful or affectionate behaviour to.
11 Purpose, design.
12 Comprehending, including.
13 Distribution, disposal.
14 Giving, presentation.
15 Blinding, misleading, deceiving.
16 Throwing Ghee on the fire, or images into a sacred stream, or any similar rite from which no advantage is expected.
E.
प्रति severally or towards, &c. पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-हः)
A large drum; the state drum allowed only to chiefs of a certain rank.
E.
प्रतिपत्ति celebrity, and पटह a drum.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Active, prompt.
2

Celebrated.
3

High in rank.
E.
प्रतिपत्ति, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Obstinate, unyielding.
E.
प्रतिपत्ति, and पराङ्मुख averse.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A kettle drum.
E.
प्रतिपट् rank, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.

f. (-पद् or पत्)
1 The first day of a lunar fortnight, the first of the moon's increase or wane.
2 Understanding, intellect.
3 Rank, consequence.
4 A kettle drum.
E.
प्रति severally, पद to go, and क्विप् aff.

ind. or n. adv. (-दं)
Step by step, at each step.
2 Continually, every moment.
E.
प्रति, and पद step.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Known, understood, ascertained, determined.
2 Promised, engaged, assented to, accepted.
3 Overcome, conquered, subdued.
4 Obtained, gained.
5 Done, effected, accomplished.
6

Undertaken.
7

Replied.
E.
प्रति again, and पद to go, aff. क्त.

n. (-णं)
1 Stake, gage, the thing played for.
2 A counter pledge, the thing staked against another.
E.
प्रति, and पण to have price, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What produces effects, causes, &c.
2 Explanatory.
E.
प्रति, and पद to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-नं)
1 Gift, donation.
2 Ascertaining, determining, rendering clear or intelligible.
3 Action, worldly conduct or interest.
4 Accomplishing, effecting.
5 Producing, causing.
E.
प्रति severally, and पद to go, causal v., aff, ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Delivered, given.
2 Caused.
E.
प्रति before पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Determining, ascertaining.
2 Making manifest or clear.
3 What causes or effects.
E.
प्रति before पद to go, causal v., उकञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what protects or defends.
m. (-कः)
1 A king.
2 A protector.
E.
प्रति before पाल to protect, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Protecting, defending, cherishing.
2 Following, practising.
E.
प्रति, and पाल to cherish, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be cherished or protected.
2 To be observed or followed.
E.
प्रति, and पाल to cherish, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cherished, protected.
2 Practised, followed.
E.
प्रति before पाल to cherish, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
